description: Fetch reviews for a single Google Hotels property via SerpAPI. Requires a `property_token` taken from a google_hotels_search result. Filter by category_token or source_number, order with sort_by, and paginate with next_page_token.

category_token.description: Token to filter reviews by a category/topic (from a prior reviews response).

next_page_token.description: Token from a prior response to fetch the next page of reviews.

no_cache.description: Force a fresh SerpAPI fetch and bypass this server's result cache. Default false.

property_token.description: Property token from a google_hotels_search result identifying the property whose reviews to fetch.

sort_by.description: Sort order: 1 = most helpful, 2 = most recent, 3 = highest rating, 4 = lowest rating.

source_number.description: Filter reviews by a specific review source (provider) number, as listed in a prior response.

zero_trace.description: Enterprise-only ZeroTrace mode: don't store search params/metadata on SerpAPI. Default false.

name: google_hotels_reviews
title: Get Google Hotels Property Reviews (SerpAPI)
